description: This file is a test script for Git's rev-list command, specifically testing the handling of missing objects in various scenarios, including error cases, printing information, and handling edge cases with missing tips or objects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, executing the provided commands to verify behavior.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error handling.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets cleanup commands to run after a test completes.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its corresponding file path within the .git/objects directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and reports if they differ, used for asserting test expectations.
